company.name: Vetcove
company.shortDescription: Vetcove is the largest B2B veterinary marketplace, enabling veterinary hospitals to compare and buy supplies from all of their vendors.
company.description: Vetcove is like Kayak.com for veterinary hospitals to order their supplies. We aggregate the catalogs of all veterinary suppliers across the country, resulting in the largest veterinary catalog in the world, spanning more than 200,000 skus and 2,100 manufacturers. Clinics search one unified catalog with rich content, compare pricing and what's in stock, and order in one place. Manufacturers, compounding pharmacies, and diagnostic laboratories manage their own product listings, receive payments, and offer free samples. For the first time ever, veterinarians and their staff can use collective insights to discover new products, buy smarter, and advance their practice of veterinary medicine. Our goal is to help vet hospitals operate profitably and assist them in providing the best possible products and services to pets and their pet parents.

insights.statement: The latest disclosed Pre Seed round raised $3,025,000, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $14,993,637 to $14,993,637, a 1x increase.
